ideas.idea: Give each page its own title and description via useHead/useSeoMeta
ideas.why: This is the same as the known problem that only app.vue sets a title, so it adds nothing new.

ideas.idea: Remove the noindex middleware or limit it to /admin
ideas.why: This is the known problem of /guides being sent X-Robots-Tag: noindex.

ideas.idea: Add actual routes with grades as text on /guides, each with its own page
ideas.why: guides.vue promises graded routes but lists none, so the page has little content for readers or machines to quote.

ideas.idea: Describe walks and areas in text on the home page
ideas.why: index.vue has only an h1 and a button, so there is almost no descriptive content.

ideas.idea: Replace the sitemap placeholder host trailhead.example with the real production domain, and use it in robots.txt and canonicals
ideas.why: sitemap.xml uses a .example placeholder host, which search engines can't use.

ideas.idea: Add an absolute canonical link on the site's domain
ideas.why: No canonical exists anywhere in the repo, and the site origin isn't declared.

ideas.idea: Fix the sitemap line in robots.txt (relative URL)
ideas.why: This is the known relative-URL problem in robots.txt.

ideas.idea: Turn on server rendering or prerender the pages
ideas.why: This is the known problem that nuxt.config.ts sets ssr: false.

ideas.idea: Use NuxtLink for the /guides link on the home page
ideas.why: This is the known problem of reaching /guides through a button.
